alloy: all s: Spec | ((no a: Axiom | cites[s, a]) and (no s2: Spec | cites[s, s2])) implies s in Freelancing
all e: Exception | (no s: Spec | cites[e, s]) implies e in Freelancing
all e: Exception | (no f: Fact | cites[e, f]) implies e in Freelancing
all t: Term | (some u: Unit | cites[t, u]) implies t in Misnesting
all u: Unit | circular[u] implies u in Cycle
(all b: Bug | hidden[b] implies b in Finding) and (all c: Conflict | hidden[c] implies c in Finding) and (all t: Test | misleading[t] implies t in Finding)
all b: Bug | hidden[b] implies b in Finding
all t: Test | misleading[t] implies t in Finding
all ef: ExpectedFailure | ((no b: Bug | checks[ef, b]) and (no e: Exception | checks[ef, e])) implies ef in UnexplainedFailure
all pt: PlainTest | (some b: Bug | checks[pt, b]) implies pt in Unpinning
all u: Unit | (not used[u] and u not in Conflict) implies u in Orphaning
all u: Unit | (some t: Trailer | t->u in Follow.rel) implies u in Misanchoring
all d: Document | ((some u: Unit | d->u in Hold.units) and (no i: Index | d->i in Hold.indexes)) implies d in Misindexing
all f: Fence, u: Unit | f->u in Within.rel implies (no v: Unit | v->f in Blocks.rel)
doubt: Interpreting 'a block of no unit' as a fence with no unit designated in the Blocks relation

alloy: all c: Claim | tested[c] implies c not in Untesting
all c: Claim | (some t: Test | t in Declared and checks[t, c]) implies c not in Untesting
all d: Document | ((some f: Listing | d->f in Head.rel and (no e: Entry | f->e in Item.rel)) and (no r: Run | d in Given)) implies (no p: Plugin | p->d in Over.rel)
all r: Run, p: Plugin | calls[r, p] implies (all d: Given | p->d in Over.rel)
all f: Frontmatter | (f not in Listing) implies (no e: Entry | f->e in Item.rel)
all d: Document | (some f: Refused | d->f in Head.rel) implies ((d in Unreadable) and (all r: Run | r in Exits2))
all d: Document | (some f: Refused | d->f in Head.rel) implies d in Unreadable
all r: Run | (some d: Document | d in Unreadable) implies r in Exits2
all r: Run | (some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) implies r in Exits2
all r: Run | ((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1) and (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2)) implies r in Exits1
all r: Run | (no p: Plugin | (r->p in Return.code1 or r->p in Return.code2)) implies r in Exits0
all d: Document, u: Unit | (d in Worded and d->u in Hold.units and u in Logical and u not in Current) implies u in Reported
all d: Document, u: Unit | ((d not in Worded) and (d->u in Hold.units)) implies ((u not in Rewritten) and (u not in Reported))
all u: Unit | ((u in Logical) and (u not in Stated) and (u not in Unsayable)) implies u in Unwritten
all u: Unit | (u in Stale) implies u in Rewritten
all u: Unit | (u in Current) implies u not in Rewritten
all u: Unit | (u in Handwritten) implies u not in Rewritten
all w: Word | (some u1, u2: Unit | u1 != u2 and u1->w in Rely.rel and u2->w in Introduce.rel) implies w in Apart
all w: Word | ((some u: Unit | u->w in Introduce.rel) and (no u: Unit | u->w in Rely.rel)) implies w in Unused

all t: Term, w: Word | ((t->w in Introduce.rel) and (t->w in Voice.rel) and (some u: Unit | u->w in Rely.rel)) implies ((w not in Flagged) and (w not in Undeclared) and (w not in Misplaced) and (w not in Apart) and (w not in Unused))

all d: Document, u1: Unit, w1: Word | ((d not in Worded) and (d->u1 in Hold.units) and (u1->w1 in Introduce.rel)) implies ((w1 not in Undeclared) and (w1 not in Misplaced) and (w1 not in Apart) and (w1 not in Unused) and (w1 not in Flagged))

all s: Search, u: Unit | (s in Trial and (some sc: Scenario | sc in s.Pose.scenario) and u in s.Leave.rel) implies ((u in Held) and (u not in s.Pose.units) and (all u2: Unit | (u2 in Held and u2 != u) implies u2 in s.Pose.units))
all sc: Scenario | ((sc in Impossible) and (no u: Unit | sc->u in Probe.rel)) implies (all u: Unit | (u in Held) implies (some s: Search | s in Trial and u in s.Leave.rel and sc in s.Pose.scenario))
all s: Search, sc: Scenario, u1: Unit | ((s in Trial) and (sc in s.Pose.scenario) and (u1 in s.Leave.rel) and (some u2: Unit | sc->u2 in Probe.rel)) implies (sc->u1 in Probe.rel)
all r: Run | ((LogicCommand in r.Ask.rel) and ((some sc: Scenario | sc in Raised) or (some u: Unit | u in Contradicting))) implies (r not in Exits0)
all d: Document, u: Unit | ((d in Checked) and (some d2: Document | d->d2 in Context.rel and d2->u in Hold.units) and (u in BareFormula)) implies (u in Held)

(all u: Unit | ((u in Logical) and (u not in Term) and (u in Unchallenged)) implies (some w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel and w in Signature)) and (all u: Unit, w: Word | (u->w in Expose.rel) implies (u in Unchallenged))
all d: Document, u: Unit | ((d not in Worded) and (d->u in Hold.units)) implies (no w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel)
all r: Run | ((CheckCommand in r.Ask.rel) and (some u: Unit, w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel)) implies (r not in Exits0)
some u: Unit, d: Document | (d in Worded and d->u in Hold.units and u in Logical and u in Current and u not in Reported)
all df: Definition | (df in AmbiguousAnd) implies (df in AsItStands)
all df: Definition | (df in NotAboutSubject) implies (df in AsItStands)
all q: Quantifier | ((q in VariableOnce) and fits[q]) implies (q in AsNounPhrase)
all ls: Series | (ls in Many) implies (ls in AsBullets)
all ls: Series | ((ls in MoreThanTwo) and (ls in CommaItem)) implies (ls in AsBullets)
all ls: Series | (ls in TooLong) implies (ls in AsBullets)
some q: Quantifier | (q in VariableSubject and q in VariableTwice)
some q: Quantifier | (q in VariableOnce and q in ConditionAside)
some q: Quantifier | (q in VariableWithCondition and q in NothingToAttach)
always (all o: Owner, c: Cleanup | ((o in Disposed and c.on = o and c in Registered and c not in Ran) implies eventually runNow[c]))
always not (some o: Owner, c: Cleanup | (throwByCall[o] or runByCall[c, o]) and o in Disposed and c.on = o and c in Registered and c not in Ran)

(always (all o1: Owner, c1, c2: Cleanup | ((o1 in Disposed and c1 in Registered and c1 not in Ran and c2 in Registered and c2 not in Ran and c1.on = o1 and c2.on = o1 and c1->c2 in Clock.older) implies ((eventually runNow[c2]) and ((not runNow[c1]) until runNow[c2]))))) and (always (all o2: Owner, c: Cleanup | ((c in Failing and runNow[c] and c.on = o2 and o2 in Disposed) implies always (o2 not in Stopped))))
